scope: Score-blind controller and ledger evidence only; no prompts, traces, task content, or capability scores were read.

defect.finding: A per-session serving-profile request ran before the atomic ledger claim. Its transient connection failure consumed one bounded worker slot without binding a cell, so one untouched cell remained pending when the controller ended.

repair.code: evals/fleet/evaluate.py and evals/fleet/rollout_worker.py run each serving-profile check after the exact ledger claim and before model execution.
repair.regression: tests/test_evaluate.py proves a profile-check exception quarantines the claimed cell and cannot leave an unrelated pending cell by consuming an unbound slot.
repair.valid_outcome_policy: No accepted pass@1 result is replayed. Existing accepted and infrastructure-invalid cells remain preserved under the frozen retry policy.
